To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

in the group of patients with diabetes, the incidence of gastric cancer and colorectal cancer, brain tumour, lymphocytic leukemia, and myeloid leukemia was higher in rural areas than in the urban areas.
in diabetic patients the incidence rate of gastric cancer, colon and rectum cancer, kidney cancer and brain tumors is higher in rural areas.

the incidence of gastric cancer and colorectal cancer in diabetic women living in urban areas was higher than the incidence of these neoplastic diseases in women living in rural areas, and the incidence of oesophagal cancer and pancreatic cancer was higher in diabetic women living rural areas.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the incidence of cancer in diabetic patients in Poland.
the incidence of selected cancers in diabetic patients in Poland.
the incidence of selected cancers in the population of diabetic patients in the urban and the rural areas in Poland.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incidence of cancer in diabetic patients living in rural areas is higher than in the urban population, but the incidence of certain cancers is significantly higher in the urban population.
in the case of male diabetic patients, the incidence of cancer in rural areas is higher in comparison with the urban population.
in the population analysed the incidence of new cancers was higher in rural areas than in urban areas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the rural areas the incidence of gastric cancer is higher than in urban areas and the incidence of pancreatic cancer in women is higher in urban areas than in rural areas.
the risk of developing certain cancers is higher in diabetic patients living in the rural areas.
the incidence of selected cancers in diabetic patients is higher in the rural population compared to the urban population.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are significant differences between the mean incidence of some selected malignancies in the urban and the rural populations.
the incidence of some types of cancers in the rural population of diabetic patients is higher than in the urban population of diabetic patients.
there is a need to carry out further studies on the incidence of new cancer in diabetic patients in Poland.
